headline.title: Santiago de Cuba and Guantánamo go dark
headline.quip: One line tripped and two provinces went dark. Eastern Cuba’s grid has now had its second door this month.
headline.summary: The 220 kV Cueto–Renté line tripped around 1:14 p.m., cutting Santiago de Cuba and Guantánamo provinces, home to about 1.4 million people, off the grid. UNE forecast a deficit of about 1,730 MW and gave no technical cause.
